description: This file implements the GetOrderDetailsHandler class, which handles requests to retrieve detailed information about an order, including order items, address, and total. It interacts with the order repository and utilizes specifications to query data.

classes.name: GetOrderDetailsHandler
classes.description: Handles the process of fetching detailed order information asynchronously, implementing IRequestHandler for GetOrderDetails request.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the GetOrderDetails request by querying the order repository, constructing an OrderDetailViewModel from the retrieved data, or returning null if the order does not exist.
